en.title: Partdro C500 Heavy-Lift Cargo Drone: 240 kg Payload, 7-Minute Fast Charge, 720 kg Cluster Lift
en.summary: The Partdro C500 sets a new benchmark for heavy-lift logistics drones: 240 kg single-drone payload, 720 kg cluster lift and 7-minute fast charging. Watch the full field video.
en.content:
Heavy payloads are the bottleneck of drone logistics — and the Partdro C500 is built to break it. In our new field video, the C500 demonstrates a 240 kg single-drone payload and a 720 kg cluster lift with multiple drones working together.

Charging takes just 7 minutes, so a C500 fleet can run continuous shuttle missions between loading and unloading points with minimal downtime. The heavy-lift frame keeps the airframe stable at maximum load, even in gusty conditions.

Typical missions include construction materials, agricultural freight, solar farm logistics and emergency supply runs — anywhere ground transport is slow, expensive or impossible.

Looking for heavy-lift drone capacity for your project? Explore the Partdro C500 or talk to our team.
